9929y-mesh-gradient-generation-root.description: A research-informed GenAI visual-generation workflow. Translate user intent and design constraints into controllable mesh gradients; generate and refine mesh gradients for presentations, web backgrounds and brand visuals, with palette selection and brand-design guidance. Use editable Figma layers or SVG/code routes for sky-inspired, dreamlike, flower-inspired, diffuse, heightmap and multipoint effects, including reference reconstruction.
